final: WITH status_avgs AS (SELECT t.equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) as avg_pulse FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry WHERE s.pulsepersec IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.equipstatus), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) as mean_val FROM status_avgs), first_filtered AS (SELECT equipstatus, avg_pulse FROM status_avgs WHERE avg_pulse > (SELECT mean_val FROM first_mean)), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) as mean_val FROM first_filtered), final_filtered AS (SELECT avg_pulse FROM first_filtered WHERE avg_pulse > (SELECT mean_val FROM second_mean)) SELECT AVG(ff.avg_pulse) as final_avg_pulse, AVG(ff.avg_pulse - fm.mean_val) as avg_excess_over_first_mean, AVG(ff.avg_pulse - sm.mean_val) as avg_excess_over_second_mean FROM final_filtered ff CROSS JOIN first_mean fm CROSS JOIN second_mean sm
